top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, mature and independently replicated chain from proglucagon and the incretin effect through the human physiology and active GLP-1(7-36) peptide to receptor biology, now validated in large randomised trials for glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-person allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov fits the physiology, and a citation saying the discoveries made incretin-based therapies possible keeps the scope honest. Attribution questions (Habener, Knudsen, Mojsov's priority) are real but are best handled as a documented caveat. They do not justify withholding the prize, so no award is ranked last.
